Subject: Vendor readiness & payment route — MedSafe / Redwood

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can get procurement unstuck from our side: 

1) Vendor packet + tax forms: To complete our vendor setup we typically need a completed vendor packet + either a W-9 (US entity) or a W-8 (non-US). Can you confirm which applies and send the form back?

2) Banking / payment instructions: Please attach whichever you prefer (ACH preferred). If you have an AP portal/vendor ID for your invoice submission, include that too.

3) Purchase path: From our discussion you indicated MedSafe prefers PO-driven payments for enterprise contracts. Can you confirm whether your AP requires a PO on file before payment (and the standard net terms)? Also, are you open to paying corporate card for the initial pilot (we can accept either — card speeds onboarding but some finance teams prefer PO).

4) Marketplace enrollment: You mentioned CloudMarket as an internal procurement option. If you want Redwood listed as a marketplace vendor we can send instructions and a short enrollment checklist — do you want us to forward steps to your marketplace contact or handle with our channel partner?

Attachments: I’ve attached our vendor packet (redwood_vendor_packet_v2.pdf) as a starting point. If you can send MedSafe_W9.pdf and bank instructions back, we’ll route to Finance.

Proposed timeline: if we receive the forms and PO preference by end of this week (Fri 4/15), we can get legal/vendor setup completed and issue the initial invoice by 4/22. 

Thanks — small list of items and happy to take them one step at a time.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

• Tax form: MedSafe is a US entity; I’ve attached our completed W-9 (MedSafe_W9.pdf).
• Banking: Attached bank instructions and ACH setup sheet (MedSafe_Bank_Instructions.pdf). Our AP team prefers ACH payments to the account listed.

• Marketplace: Tom (cc’d) manages our CloudMarket enrollments. Tom, can you confirm who should receive Redwood’s marketplace invite? If it’s helpful, Naomi can send the marketplace onboarding checklist directly to onboard@cloudmarket.com.

We’ve also completed the vendor packet fields we could; happy to sign anything through DocuSign.

Looping in Redwood Finance to confirm a couple items before we finalize: 

1) Bank validation: Ben — I’ll need you to confirm the ACH fields Lisa provided match our payment processor requirements. If anything is missing (e.g., intermediary bank for international wires), flag it now.
2) Payment terms: Our standard for pilots is invoice on completion with 30 net days. If MedSafe will be using PO for the larger agreement, we’ll accept PO + Net 30. Card payments can be used for faster processing but will carry the usual merchant fees (let us know if you want Redwood to absorb fees for the pilot).
3) Marketplace vs direct billing: Marketplace invoicing routes sometimes add a 7–10 business day processing delay. If speed is the priority for the pilot, recommend card or direct PO to avoid marketplace lag.

We’ll wait for Tom’s confirmation on marketplace enrollment and for Lisa to complete the DocuSign signature. Once signed, Finance will issue the invoice draft and Ben will start validation.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Finance Lead, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
